dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Rhinocerebral mucormycosis with orbital and orbital apex invasion in newly diagnosed diabetes mellitus.

Alternative 1: Invasive sino-orbital aspergillosis.
Alternative 2: Bacterial orbital cellulitis from acute invasive sinusitis with cavernous sinus thrombosis.
Alternative 3: Sino-nasal malignancy (squamous cell carcinoma or non-Hodgkin lymphoma) with orbital invasion.
